definitions.explanation: An establishment where hairdressing, hair styling, coloring, and other beauty treatments are provided. Traditionally associated with women's hairdressing services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧{美容院|びよういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made an appointment at the beauty salon for tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {美容院|びよういん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|そ}めて→染める：04253_someru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my hair dyed at the beauty salon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{美容院|びよういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new beauty salon opened in front of the station.

notes:
{美容院|びよういん} is a beauty salon or hair salon.

SERVICES OFFERED:
- ⟦カット→カット：10818_katto⟧ (haircut)
- ⟦パーマ→パーマ：28205_paama⟧ (perm)
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧ / ⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧ (hair coloring)
- ⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧ (shampoo)
- ⟦トリートメント→トリートメント：29565_toriitomento⟧ (hair treatment)
- ⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (styling)

CONTRAST WITH BARBERSHOP:
- {美容院|びよういん} / ⟦{美容室|びようしつ}→美容室：20238_biyoushitsu⟧: beauty salon (traditionally for women, offers styling, coloring, perms)
- ⟦{理髪店|りはつてん}→理髪店：06320_rihatsuten⟧ / ⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧: barbershop (traditionally for men, offers simple cuts, shaving)

MODERN USAGE:
Today, many {美容院|びよういん} also serve male customers, and the distinction between beauty salons and barbershops has become less strict.

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{美容室|びようしつ}→美容室：20238_biyoushitsu⟧: beauty salon (synonym)
